root.label: Milorad Dodik convicted and removed from Republika Srpska presidency

events.label: Milorad Dodik convicted and removed from Republika Srpska presidency

slots.name: conviction count
slots.sentence: A Sarajevo court last year convicted Dodik of failing to comply with the terms of Bosnia's 1995 peace accords.

slots.name: political office status
slots.sentence: He was then removed as president and banned from holding political office by Bosnia's electoral authorities.
